title: Snowy Hub | Auto Farm, Auto Steal, Auto Hatch, TP & More
features:
Fly – Adjustable flight speed from 1–200.

Invincibility – Protects against kill parts, lava, and damage parts.

Float – Adjustable movement, ascend, and descend speeds.

Noclip – Walk through obstacles.

Invisible – Makes your character invisible.

Infinite Jump – Allows continuous jumping.

Fall Protect – Prevents deaths from high falls.

Jump ESP – Highlights your character while jumping or falling.

Player ESP – Highlights other players.

Set Checkpoint – Saves your current position.

Teleport to Checkpoint – Teleports you back to your saved position.

Checkpoint Visual – Displays a ghost clone and ESP label at your checkpoint.

Checkpoint Keybinds – Use C to set and V to teleport.

Clear Checkpoint – Removes your saved checkpoint.

Teleport to End – Teleports directly to the end.

Auto Farm – Automatically cycles through tower finishes.

Auto Farm Interval – Adjusts the farming cycle from 0–8 minutes.

Impersonate Player – Applies another player's avatar locally.

Custom Jump Height – Adjusts jump height from 0–500.

Freecam – Enables free camera movement with WASD.

Freecam Up/Down – Use E and Q to move the freecam vertically.

Freecam Speed – Adjusts freecam speed from 0.1–10.
